_comment: Identical to ic/nominal/params.json except omega, the drive frequency, multiplied by (1 + 1e-15) - about four ulps of binary64. omega enters the Dyson integrals continuously, so every propagator matrix element moves at round-off only; the nominal-versus-variant spread is the measured floor of this check. Note this check has NO ODE integrator in its path, so its floor is set by the closed-form integral evaluation and is expected near machine precision - the tightest floor in the module.
